items.title: Jayden Daniels: Strong fantasy night in loss
items.text:
Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding four rushes for 10 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

items.title: George Kittle: Back in end zone in Week 6 win
items.text:
Kittle brought in five of eight targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night.

items.title: Brock Purdy: Another efficient effort in win
items.text:
Purdy completed 21 of 29 passes for 264 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 28 yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night.

items.title: Mike Evans: Expected to miss some time
items.text:
Evans is expected to miss some time after aggravating his Achilles injury in Monday night's 23-17 win over the Commanders, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Two touchdowns in Week 6 win
items.text:
McCaffrey rushed 16 times for 64 yards and two touchdowns and brought in nine of 10 targets for 53 yards in the 49ers' 23-17 win over the Commanders on Monday night. He also lost a fumble.
